question: When the CFB engine identified a MODERATE or STRONG CONTROL edge before kickoff in 2026, did buying that side in the Kalshi game-winner market at the pre-registered pregame executable price produce positive fee-adjusted returns?

football.control_rule: scripting.claims.derive_claims(...)['control'] over the production findings: {SIDE}_SUSTAINED_EFFICIENCY_ADVANTAGE, NET_THRESHOLD=(1.0 MODERATE, 2.0 STRONG), uncertainty gate abs(net) >= uncertainty; tier = finding strength
football.replay: archetype_research.replay.history_for + build_pregame_content (production build_content on gamelog.before(rows, data_cutoff(kickoff)), availability OBSERVED_CLEAN as in Waves 1-2)

populations.RETROSPECTIVE_FOOTBALL_REPLAY_WITH_PROSP: every completed 2026 game in the frozen game log (both teams present, both scores present, oriented by the frozen ESPN schedule) with kickoff before 2026-10-08T01:39:58Z (first V2 ledger write); CONTROL reconstructed by replay at the production cutoff
populations.PROSPECTIVE_V2_CONTROL: V2 ledger rows (origin/script-ledger data/scripting/ledger/2026/publications_v2.jsonl) of kind FINAL_PREGAME for games completed by the data freeze; CONTROL tier read from the row, never recomputed
populations.pooling: pooled tables are always shown beside each population separately

market.family: game winner only: series KXNCAAFGAME (no spreads, totals, team totals, halves, margins, ladders)

RESEARCH_OBSERVATION.filter: observation.kalshi_market_ticker starts with KXNCAAFGAME- (any family label)

CATALOG_SNAPSHOT.commits: every commit touching data/live up to be483103e9c6f895047f0a410d64906ba59c00ae
CATALOG_SNAPSHOT.timestamp: data/live/cfb_catalog_status.json captured_at at the same commit
CATALOG_SNAPSHOT.filter: market.series_ticker == KXNCAAFGAME or market_ticker starts with KXNCAAFGAME-; sentinel full-width books rejected

market.kickoff_reference: ESPN kickoff_utc of the game in the frozen game log

orientation.rule: each KXNCAAFGAME market <event>-<CODE> pays YES iff team CODE wins. The market is resolved to an ESPN competitor by (1) team codes: the event key splits into two codes equal to the ESPN abbreviations of a schedule event within 36 h, and CODE equals one abbreviation; (2) names: the market's team name (catalog yes_sub_title; observation game_id slug side named by observation.team) matches exactly one competitor's production name keys in the schedule event matched within 36 h. Both resolve and disagree -> ORIENTATION_CONFLICT; neither -> ORIENTATION_UNRESOLVED; the two markets of an event resolving to the same competitor -> ORIENTATION_CONFLICT. Excluded before any outcome is read.
orientation.primary_contract: CONTROL team's own market, YES side, priced at its executable YES ask
orientation.secondary_contract_descriptive: opponent's market, NO side, priced at its own executable NO ask (never 1 - YES)

market.valid_quote: side ask price p in dollars with 0.01 <= p <= 0.99 and p*100 an integer (1e-9 tolerance); market status, when recorded, in {active, open}; captured strictly before kickoff; catalog sentinel books rejected. Missing stays missing: no imputation, no complement.

entry_checkpoint_primary.name: PRIMARY_60_180
entry_checkpoint_primary.rule: LAST valid executable quote of the primary contract with kickoff-180min <= captured_at <= kickoff-60min
entry_checkpoint_primary.missing: ENTRY_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE (excluded from primary economics; never searched outside the window)

descriptive_checkpoints.EARLY_OPEN: first valid quote ever captured before kickoff
descriptive_checkpoints.W_180_360: last valid quote with kickoff-360min <= t < kickoff-180min
descriptive_checkpoints.W_15_60: last valid quote with kickoff-60min < t <= kickoff-15min
descriptive_checkpoints.CLOSING: last valid quote with kickoff-60min < t < kickoff

fees.formula: calculate_fee_cents(price_cents, 1, TAKER, M): ceil to whole cent of M*0.07*1*P*(1-P), computed at the captured entry price of the side bought
fees.unavailable: price not an integer cent or outside [1,99] -> FEE_UNAVAILABLE; economics unavailable; never fee = 0

settlement.value: $1 if the CONTROL team won the game, else $0 (one research contract)
settlement.source_primary: final score in the frozen production game log (Kalshi game-winner rules resolve on the official winner)
settlement.cross_check: official_kalshi_settlement / derived_contract_settlement for the same ticker in research-data attributions or settlements where present; any disagreement -> SETTLEMENT_MISMATCH (excluded)

economics.unit: one game, one CONTROL side, one KXNCAAFGAME contract, one research contract; no staking, bankroll, Kelly, sizing, parlays or selection

clv.closing: CLOSING checkpoint of the SAME contract and side; must be captured after the entry quote
clv.missing: CLOSE_MISSING; never zero-filled; clv_n reported beside n

uncertainty.method: nonparametric bootstrap resampling games with replacement (each row is one game), percentile 95% interval

verdict_rules.evaluable: n_primary (rows with entry quote, fee and settlement) >= 20, else INSUFFICIENT_DATA
verdict_rules.EVIDENCE_OF_UNDERPRICING: evaluable, ROI > 0, ROI 95% lower bound > 0, n_primary >= 50, clv_n >= 10 and mean CLV > 0
verdict_rules.OVERPRICED: evaluable, ROI <= 0 and ROI 95% upper bound < 0
verdict_rules.APPROXIMATELY_EFFICIENT: evaluable, ROI <= 0 and ROI 95% interval includes 0
verdict_rules.overall: all tiers INSUFFICIENT -> INSUFFICIENT 2026 MARKET DATA; every evaluable tier EVIDENCE_OF_UNDERPRICING -> 2026 CONTROL SHOWS MARKET UNDERPRICING; every evaluable tier APPROXIMATELY_EFFICIENT -> 2026 CONTROL FOOTBALL SIGNAL HOLDS BUT MARKET IS APPROXIMATELY EFFICIENT; every evaluable tier OVERPRICED -> 2026 CONTROL SIDE IS OVERPRICED BY THE MARKET; otherwise 2026 CONTROL RESULTS ARE MIXED BY TIER / PRICE
verdict_rules.football_continuing: per tier: CONSISTENT if the 2026 Wilson 95% interval contains or exceeds the development win rate; BELOW_HISTORICAL if its upper bound is below it; INSUFFICIENT if n < 20

sensitivities_descriptive_only: secondary contract: opponent market NO at its own ask
replay eligibility subset (both teams >= 1 prior game, profile and baseline defined)
stages: 2 FREEZE: population, CONTROL tiers and every selected quote written to a manifest with no outcome read; manifest hashed and committed
3 REVEAL: settlement joined, hashes re-checked, report generated once
forbidden: changing any threshold, tier, window, bucket or rule after stage 2
a bet-up-to price derived from these rows
recommendation, stake, play or +EV language in any conclusion field
